definitions.explanation: Equipment worn to protect the body from injury or hazards, such as helmets, goggles, gloves, and masks used in workplaces and sports.

examples.japanese: {保護具|ほごぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
⟦{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}→作業中：22739_sagyouchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保護具|ほごぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧だ。
examples.english: Wearing protective gear is mandatory during work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬品|やくひん}→薬品：11055_yakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧や⟦ゴーグル→ゴーグル：07086_googuru⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保護具|ほごぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: When handling chemicals, protective gear such as gloves and goggles is essential.

notes:
A general term for equipment worn to protect the body. Built from ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ (protection) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (implement; gear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保護具|ほごぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}する→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧: to wear protective gear
- {保護具|ほごぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off protective gear
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{保護具|ほごぐ}: safety protective equipment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{防具|ぼうぐ}→防具：14659_bougu⟧: protective gear (esp. in martial arts)
